Name: Wildroot Chronicles-Cropgenics
Author: Owenynk112
Description:
[color=#d9ead3][b][font=Comic Sans MS]You've planted parsnips a thousand times.
But this time is different — some grow faster, or draw a drift of butterflies...
Your crops have started to grow a character of their own![/font][/b][/color]

[code]Cropgenics turns your farm into a living breeding garden: spot mutations, sample their traits, cross them into permanent named varieties that are yours alone. No two farms end up growing the same plants.

At a glance:

- 64 discoverable traits — growth speed, yield, quality, colors, and 20+ purely visual traits like glows, butterflies, koi ponds, and falling petals
- 9 legendary flowers that only fully bloom under precise rituals. Tailor them into garments that carry their aura
- 5 new NPCs (two fully romanceable & marriageable now)
- 20+ story events and two full romance lines
- Visit The Primal Grove — a hidden jungle expedition area.
- The Breeding Almanac & Polaroid album — a hand-illustrated journal that fills itself as you document strains and photograph your discoveries
- Exhibition Tent — invite villagers to pose with your best creations.
- Multiplayer support with shared progress.
- Localized in English and 简体中文; full gamepad support[/code][size=4][color=#38761d][b][i]NEW IN VERSION 1.2.0 — THE PRIMAL GROVE [/i][/b][/color][/size]
The Primal Grove expands Cropgenics beyond the farm with a new region built around gathering, research, fishing, combat, and exploration. Discover 17 new traits and six new crop lines, meet three new friendship characters, and bring your findings home through new machines, recipes, equipment, and research rewards.
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/48079/48079-1784348066-1667516023.png[/img]
[font=Georgia][b][color=#ff0000][size=5]！Update Roadmap！[/size][/color][/b][/font]

[spoiler][font=Georgia][i][b][color=#ffff00][size=5]Major Content Updates[/size][/color]
[/b][/i][b][color=#ffe599][size=4]1.The Night Watchers’ Guild（2 weeks）[/size][/color][/b]
A new explorable map. New NPCs, and new rare species from other mods！
[b][color=#ffe599][size=4]2.Zuzu City University[/size][/color][/b]
New location, events, and story content set in Zuzu City.
3. And more...
[i][b]
[color=#ffd966][size=5]Quality-of-Life and Polish（over different versions)[/size][/color][/b][/i]
1.Improve the overall systems.
2.Streamline interactions and reduce unnecessary or repetitive operations.
3.Improve guidance and feedback for mechanics that may currently be difficult to understand.
4.Rework and enhance cosmetic effects, animations, and visual feedback to make traits and special interactions feel more distinctive and visually impressive.

[i][color=#ffff00][size=5]Other Plans[/size][/color][/i]
[i][b]Lite version[/b][/i]
[i]Once the main version reaches a sufficiently stable state, a separate Lite version is planned for release.[/i]
[i][color=#a61c00]The Lite version will focus primarily on the mod’s characters, maps, dialogue, and story content. Breeding and other major gameplay systems will not be included[/color], making it more suitable for players who are mainly interested in exploring the new areas and meeting the characters.[/i][/font][/spoiler]
[line]
[font=Comic Sans MS][i][b][size=4][color=#ffe599]Want to know more? You can [/color][color=#cc0000]use the offline wiki provided in the optional files[/color][color=#ffe599], which contains various [/color][color=#cc0000]storylines, unlock conditions for items, and their usage instructions![/color][/size][/b] [/i][/font]
[line]

[font=Comic Sans MS][color=#ffe599][size=5][i]THE BREEDING SYSTEM [/i][/size][/color][/font]

[font=Comic Sans MS][size=4]🧬 [i][color=#b6d7a8]EVERY HARVEST TELLS A STORY[/color][/i][/size][/font]
[font=Comic Sans MS]Your crops are no longer static. Plant a crop and, every so often, one comes up different — a quirk in how it grows, its color, the way it shimmers at dusk.[/font]
[font=Comic Sans MS]Over 40 inheritable traits, including:[/font]
[list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][i][b]Practical mutations[/b][/i] — faster growth, faster regrowth, bigger yields, higher quality, hardier plants...[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][b][i]Visual effects[/i][/b] — a soft night glow, drifting particles, butterflies and fireflies, petal rain...[/font][/*]
[/list][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/48079/48079-1784386956-1192676141.gif[/img]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/48079/48079-1784386957-792050921.gif[/img]
[font=Comic Sans MS][b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/48079/48079-1784381328-1695063102.gif[/img][/b][/font]

[font=Comic Sans MS][b][i][color=#93c47d][size=4]🌾 BREED, STABILIZE, AND NAME YOUR OWN VARIETIES[/size][/color][/i][/b][/font]
[font=Comic Sans MS]Use the Pruning Shears to take samples, then combine them at the [b][color=#f1c232]Breeding Station[/color][/b]:[/font]
[font=Comic Sans MS][b][i][color=#b6d7a8]Plant → mutate → sample → breed → stabilize → inherit[/color][/i][/b][/font]
[font=Comic Sans MS]Your new seeds pass their traits down to their offspring, and you get to name your own varieties. Over time, your farm becomes a curated lineage of self-designed crops. Some traits even have levels — breed a mutated sample with a parent that shares the same trait to raise it further.[/font]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/48079/48079-1784991900-1033845009.png[/img]
[line]
[size=5][font=Georgia]😉[color=#dd7e6b]Meet Custom Characters！[/color][/font][/size]
[font=Comic Sans MS][color=#6d9eeb][size=4][b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/48079/48079-1785005515-318619839.png[/img][/b][/size][/color][/font]
[font=Comic Sans MS][color=#6d9eeb][b][size=4]🌿[/size][i][size=4]FERNANDO[/size]（romanceable）[/i][/b][/color][/font]
[font=Comic Sans MS]A former Zuzu City academic who left institutional research for a half-collapsed cabin south of Cindersap Forest, drawn by the valley's unusually active plant life. Deadpan on the surface and warmer than his spreadsheets suggest, he's less interested in your farm than in [i]why[/i] it works.[/font]

[font=Comic Sans MS][b][color=#ead1dc][size=4]💮[/size][i][size=4]ORIKO [/size]（romanceable）[/i][/color][/b][/font]
[font=Comic Sans MS]A traveling flower-seeker chasing the memory of a blue rose that glowed in the dark and led her down the mountain. Soft-spoken and sharper than she lets on, she plays her pipa on the hillside, notices what everyone else walks past, and is still searching for the valley's other legendary blooms.[/font]

[font=Comic Sans MS][color=#8e7cc3][size=4][b][i]🔍Felix[/i][/b][/size][/color][/font]
[font=Comic Sans MS]Fernando's junior colleague from the Zuzu City research group — brilliant with data, impatient with everything else, and far happier with a model than a muddy field site. [/font]

[color=#ffe599][size=4][font=Comic Sans MS][b][i]🍯Ariel[/i][/b][/font][/size][/color]
[font=Comic Sans MS]A second-year archaeology student who came for the course credit and stayed for the fieldwork. Talk fast, interrupt constantly, but warmer than anyone else.[/font]

[color=#666666][size=4][font=Comic Sans MS][b][i]🌃[/i][/b][/font][/size][/color][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#666666][size=4][b][i]Laurent[/i][/b][/size][/color][/font]
[font=Comic Sans MS]A captain from the Nightwatch,who maps hazards, marks retreat routes, and decides what gets hunted, driven off, or left alone.Courteous, unhurried, and quietly edged; the Grove is only one patch of his territory, but he becomes part of everyday camp life all the same.[/font]

[line]
[i][color=#a64d79][size=4]🌸 HUNT THE LEGENDARY BLOOMS[/size][/color][/i]
Beyond ordinary traits, the valley hides legendary flowers that only reach full bloom under specific ecological conditions — season, weather, neighboring crops, time of day. The Almanac records clues, but the valley doesn't give up every answer at once.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/48079/48079-1784990433-1100165259.png[/img]
[line]

[font=Comic Sans MS][color=#cccccc][size=4]📖[i] KEEP A BREEDING ALMANAC[/i][/size][/color][/font]
[font=Comic Sans MS]Every trait, mutation, and rare species you find is logged into a handcrafted Almanac. Track genetic inheritance, document your discovered variants, and follow your evolutionary progress at a glance.[/font]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/48079/48079-1784991194-35317566.png[/img]
[line]

[font=Comic Sans MS][color=#ffd966][size=4]🏛️[i] SHOW IN THE EXHIBITION TENT[/i][/size][/color][/font]
[font=Comic Sans MS]Once unlocked, raise [i][b][color=#ffff00]an Exhibition Tent beside the Community Center to display your best flowers and curated crops[/color][/b][/i]. [i][b][color=#a64d79]Invite villagers to pose, stage scenes, and build living dioramas of your farm's evolution.[/color][/b][/i][/font]
[font=Comic Sans MS]Your farm becomes more than a production line. It becomes a living collection.[/font]
[font=Comic Sans MS][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/48079/48079-1783137107-1454898450.png[/img][/font]

[line]


[font=Comic Sans MS][b][color=#ff7700][size=5][i]Breed your way into the story！[/i][/size][/color][/b][/font]

[font=Comic Sans MS][i][size=4]PROGRESSION TIPS [/size][/i][/font]
[list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Natural mutations begin appearing [b][color=#6aa84f]after your first Bus Stop encounter[/color][/b].[/font]
[/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]A mutated crop doesn't lock in its trait until you sample it — important for traits tied to festivals, weather, or time of day.[/font]
[/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Advanced systems (Trait Extraction, batch processing) [b][i][color=#3c78d8]unlock gradually through the questline and by befriending Fernando[/color][/i][/b], giving you full genetic control over time. [/font][/*]
[/list][list=1]
5.Reaching 6 hearts with Fernando unlocks a machine for mass-breeding a chosen crop line. Combined with trait extraction, this greatly speeds up variety expansion and trait transfer.[/list][line]

[font=Comic Sans MS][b][color=#e06666][size=4][i]🔧 INSTALLATION[/i][/size][/color][/b][/font]
[list=1]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Install [color=#cc0000]SMAPI (4.0.0+)[/color] and [color=#cc0000]Spacecore.[/color][/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Unzip Cropgenics into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder. [/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/font][/*]
[/list][font=Comic Sans MS]Requires Stardew Valley 1.6. [b][i][color=#c27ba0]Generic Mod Config Menu optional.[/color][/i][/b][/font]
[line]
[font=Comic Sans MS][i][color=#d8d8d8][size=4]⚙️ COMPATIBILITY[/size][/color][/i][/font]
[font=Comic Sans MS]✅ Most expansion mods — compatibility included[/font]
[font=Comic Sans MS]✅ Multiplayer — supported, with shared progress [/font]
[font=Comic Sans MS]✅ Works with most vanilla and mod-added crops that follow the game's standard crop data structure[/font]

[line]
[font=Comic Sans MS][i][b][size=4]🐛 BUGS & SUGGESTIONS[/size][/b][/i][/font]
[font=Comic Sans MS]Cropgenics is still growing. If something breaks, include steps to reproduce and your SMAPI log (upload at smapi.io/log and paste the link in the Posts tab). [/font]
[font=Comic Sans MS][b][color=#e69138][size=4]Suggestions — new traits, rare flowers, balance feedback, event ideas — are just as welcome; I read every post.[/size][/color][/b][/font]

[font=Comic Sans MS][i][b][size=4]❤️ SPECIAL THANKS[/size][/b][/i][/font]
[font=Comic Sans MS]To the Stardew Valley modding community, the SMAPI team, the wiki contributors, and everyone who tried Cropgenics early, reported bugs, or simply enjoys growing strange little plants. 🌱😊[/font]

[size=4][font=Georgia]Thanks to these video creators for being willing to try and showcase the mod during its early versions![/font][/size]

Adds Fernando, Oriko, Felix, Ariel, and Laurent; the Breeding Almanac and exhibition tent; and a Primal Grove research camp with gathering, fishing, barter, and story progression.
